notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.19.17
Updates to Selective Color and Selective Luma Correction: Turning them from the sledgehammer they were to a finesse tool. Finer resolution on the sliders and a new Soft Mask checkbox to make the mask strength dynamic based on the underlying chroma or luma strengths in your image. Allows MUCH improved control.

Updates to WIMI: Show Active Object Name, Zoom to Object updated to zoom all the way to the edge, objects drawn as ellipses and rotated for those with semi and major axis catalogued.

Bug fixes in Stacking Suite and Magnitude Tool. PixelMath help and glossary updated to include Variable assignment.
